##Shusaku's Diagonal A move made famous by [this classic fuseki](29461) that is a steady response to White's approach. Black can now aim at pincering or pressing down the lone white stone. **Tenuki** and are strongly preferred by current professionals.
is the traditional move. [Explanation by Here We Go on Youtube (DDK/SDK)](https://youtu.be/EeVDVNg1hTs?si=qNDhSGvb_3UWsOaK)
